title: Robinhood CEO urges U.S. to clear path for tokenized stocks as overseas markets advance
summary: Vlad Tenev says tokenized stocks could bring real-time settlement and 24/7 trading, but U.S. rules remain a hurdle.

title: U.S. accounting-standards group proposes way to see stablecoins as 'cash equivalent'
summary: The Financial Accounting Standards Board, a nonprofit that governs accounting practices, proposed that certain stablecoins should fit the bill as cash-like.

title: U.S. SEC proposes first major crypto rule in surprise announcement
summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission issued the "Regulation Crypto" proposal after having cancelled a meeting days before meant to vote on it.

title: Wyoming joins $15 billion LayerZero exodus with state stablecoin move
summary: This is the first time a U.S. government entity has publicly replaced its blockchain infrastructure specifically on security grounds.

title: Bitcoin has gone quiet as traders chase ‘5x or 10x’ payoffs elsewhere
summary: Bitcoin's price swings have hit a cycle low, squeezed by a market tug-of-war with no clear winner. The traders who once lived off its chaos have taken their risk appetite elsewhere.
